verdict.rationale: Docs confirm ACH credits and debits (push/pull) and returns handled via an 'Update an ACH endpoint' pattern suggesting first-class transfer objects, but there's no evidence of same-day ACH windows, NOC (notification of change) handling, reversals, or webhook events tied to ACH lifecycle changes. missing for 10: same-day ACH window support, NOC objects/webhooks, reversal handling, explicit webhook event documentation for ACH status changes.
